sourceSettings.title: {{name}} settings
sourceSettings.noSettings: This source has no configurable options
sourceSettings.resetConfirm: Reset all settings of this source to their defaults? Unsaved changes are discarded and login information is cleared as well.
sourceSettings.clearConfirm: Clear this source's login cookies and restart its instance? You will need to log in again.
sourceSettings.localOneshotsDirDesc: A directory whose path contains this name (case-insensitive) is never listed itself; every archive directly inside becomes its own one-chapter manga titled by the file name. Leaving the field blank disables the oneshots rule for this source; resetting restores the server config (SUMIDOKU_LOCAL_ONESHOTS_DIR).
sourceSettings.localExclusionsDesc: A path containing any of these substrings (case-insensitive) is skipped by the scan
sourceSettings.localScanFlagsDesc: These override the server config fallbacks for this instance; scan-affecting changes trigger a rescan automatically
sourceSettings.resetLocalConfirm: Clear this local source's overrides (oneshots, exclusions and the scan toggles)? The directory list is kept.
